text: Toyota Industries Corporation became part of a private Toyota family holding chain on 30 March 2026: the tender offer by Toyota Asset Preparatory Co., Ltd. (established by Toyota Fudosan Co., Ltd.) completed on 23 March 2026 with a majority of voting rights, making the offeror Toyota Industries' parent company. Toyota Asset Preparatory is 100% held by Toyota Asset Co., Ltd., which is 100% held by Toyota Fudosan Co., Ltd.
short: Toyota Industries is now controlled by Toyota Fudosan's tender-offer vehicle.

source.name: Toyota Industries Corporation: Notice Concerning Result of the Tender Offer for the Company Shares by Toyota Fudosan Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company, Major Shareholders (TSE/filing translation)
source.quote: the Offeror will newly become the Company's parent company, major shareholder, and the largest shareholder of major shareholders
